# scenario whois_replies: what the core told the UI, and where it ended up.
# Recorded from internal/irc + internal/state. Regenerate with
# `go test ./internal/transcript -update`, and read doc.go before you do.

stream registration
	conn "connecting"
	conn "ready"
	conn "registering"
	rail
	self <eco>
	status server "- irc.test Message of the Day -"
	status server "- testsrv, a scripted fake server"
	status server "Connected! You are eco"
	status server "End of /MOTD command."
	status server "This server was created at the beginning of the test"
	status server "Welcome to the TestNet IRC Network eco"
	status server "Your host is irc.test, running version testsrv-1"

stream 0 S: :irc.test 311 eco alice alice test * :Alice Example
	status server "alice is alice@test (Alice Example)"

stream 1 S: :irc.test 312 eco alice irc.test :Test Network
	status server "alice is connected via irc.test (Test Network)"

stream 2 S: :irc.test 313 eco alice :is an IRC operator
	status server "alice is an IRC operator"

stream 3 S: :irc.test 317 eco alice 42 1700000000 :seconds idle, signon time
	status server "alice has been idle 42 seconds"

stream 4 S: :irc.test 319 eco alice :@#eco +#dev
	status server "alice is in: @#eco +#dev"

stream 5 S: :irc.test 330 eco alice aliceacct :is logged in as
	status server "alice is logged in as aliceacct"

stream 6 S: :irc.test 671 eco alice :is using a secure connection
	status server "alice is using a secure connection"

stream 7 S: :irc.test 318 eco alice :End of /WHOIS list
	status server "End of WHOIS for alice"
